wall_microwave_niche.description: Wall unit with top-hung door - 1 top-hung door - 1 adaptable microwave oven niche - 1 shelf
wall_microwave_niche.notes: THE SECOND MICROWAVE-NICHE UNIT, AND THE SECOND TIME IT IS THE SECTION HEIGHT MINUS 360. PE0696 is 360 in the H.72 section, PG0696 is 480 in the H.84 section. Two instances is an OBSERVATION and not a rule - the third family to print one decides. It also gains a shelf that PE0696 does not print. Not object_class appliance_front: the niche is an opening in a Cesar carcass, and the machine that goes in it is the client's and nobody's order line here.

front_layout.note: One door covering the full front of a 480-tall box, hinged along its top edge. The niche is interior and is not drawn.
